Game Overview

Deadly Zombie Virus is a zombie title where quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Deadly Zombie Virus is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Deadly Zombie Virus?

Deadly Zombie Virus is a free zombie game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Deadly Zombie Virus free to play?

Yes, Deadly Zombie Virus is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
